summary: Tantech Holdings Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its legal counsel. The company dismissed Kaufman & Canoles, P.C. effective August 2, 2026, and engaged Womble Bond Dickinson (US) LLP as its new counsel on August 3, 2025. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter with no special-situation implications, no financial terms, and no impact on shareholders. The filing was signed by CEO Zheyuan Liu. As an administrative disclosure, it does not qualify as an activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation. No deal terms are stated.
